get.summary: Fetch the last available data in the applicationTraffic table for a device

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account identifier.

parameters.name: aggregationLevel
parameters.description: Group the results by an account or site. This is useful for aggregating data over a specific dimension.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: List of device identifiers with UUID format.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: List of site identifiers.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter rows where time_ms is greater than or equal to this value. Must be in ISO 8601 format. Required unless latestBy is set; when latestBy is set and 'from' is omitted it defaults to (now - 1 hour).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter rows where the timestamp is less than this value. Must be in ISO 8601 format. If not provided, it defaults to the current time.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: List of column names to filter the data.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limits the number of rows returned.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Duration of each aggregation period in seconds. Must be a multiple of 60 (1 minute).

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Columns over which to apply the aggregation maximum. Only scalar columns are supported.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Columns over which to apply the aggregation minimum. Only scalar columns are supported.

parameters.name: avg
parameters.description: Columns over which to apply the aggregation average. Only scalar columns are supported.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Columns over which to apply the aggregation count. Only scalar columns are supported.

parameters.name: sum
parameters.description: Columns over which to apply the aggregation sum. Only scalar columns are supported.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: List of column names to sort the results by.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: List of sort orders corresponding to each column: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. If not provided, defaults to 'asc'.

parameters.name: latestPerDevice
parameters.description: [Deprecated — use latestBy=deviceId.] If true, returns only rows from the latest ingest batch per device_id (rows whose time_ms equals max(time_ms) for each device under the same WHERE clause). Optional deviceId/siteId filters narrow results; when omitted, the latest ingest batch is resolved for every device in the account within the same time window. Mutually exclusive with aggregation parameters (period, aggregationLevel, max, min, avg, count, sum) and returns 400 if combined with any of them. When true, 'from' and 'to' become optional and default to (now - 1 hour) and now respectively if omitted.

parameters.name: latestBy
parameters.description: Selects the row(s) with the latest time_ms per partition. Allowed value: 'deviceId' (returns rows whose time_ms equals max(time_ms) per device_id under the same WHERE clause). Optional deviceId/siteId filters narrow results; when omitted, the latest ingest batch is resolved for every device in the account within the same time window. Mutually exclusive with aggregation parameters (period, aggregationLevel, max, min, avg, count, sum) and returns 400 if combined with any of them. When set, 'from' and 'to' become optional and default to (now - 1 hour) and now respectively if omitted. Replaces the deprecated latestPerDevice flag.

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid authentication credentials

403.description: Forbidden - Not authorized to access the requested resource

404.description: Not found - The requested resource was not found
